name: 30240 · Lagrange, GA
findings: ZIP 30240 (Lagrange) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30240 (Lagrange) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30240 (Lagrange) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
